name: Freddie Mac PMMS
tagline: Weekly U.S. mortgage rate benchmarks from Freddie Mac's Primary Mortgage Market Survey.
description: Freddie Mac publishes the Primary Mortgage Market Survey (PMMS), the industry-standard weekly snapshot of U.S. average mortgage rates for 30-year fixed, 15-year fixed, and other products. Data is used by lenders, housing apps, and financial models as a rate benchmark; access is typically via downloadable series or third-party/open data feeds rather than a classic self-serve developer API key product.

auth.details: Public web pages and downloadable data files; no self-serve developer API key product confirmed on official PMMS pages.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public survey data pages and historical downloads appear free for typical use; commercial API terms not published on official PMMS pages

example.response_snippet: HTML marketing/data page for Primary Mortgage Market Survey (PMMS) with current weekly rate highlights and links to historical series downloads.

use_cases: get latest weekly 30-year fixed mortgage rate benchmark
pull historical PMMS rate series for charts or models
compare current rates to prior week for housing market dashboards
benchmark lender quotes against Freddie Mac PMMS averages
